steps.component: Bounded pre-lockscreen video controller, systemd unit, durable config and supplied clip
steps.health_check: test -x /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-preload-cinema && test -f /etc/nuxel/boot/preload-cinema.json && test -f /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-preload-cinema.service && test -s /usr/share/nuxel/preload/nuxel-preloading-screen.mp4 && test "$(sha256sum /usr/share/nuxel/preload/nuxel-preloading-screen.mp4 | cut -d' ' -f1)" = b059f121e62b167fde8664e24c879ca443df8740d95441e7948abdbcc6cdbbf1 && grep -q '"asset_sha256": "b059f121e62b167fde8664e24c879ca443df8740d95441e7948abdbcc6cdbbf1"' /etc/nuxel/boot/preload-cinema.json && test -x /usr/bin/mpv && python3 -m py_compile /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-preload-cinema && systemctl is-enabled --quiet nuxel-preload-cinema.service
steps.rollback: restore each <target>.nuxel-rollback; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl disable --now nuxel-preload-cinema.service 2>/dev/null || true; remove /etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/nuxel-preload-cinema.service if it remains
